name.zh: 艾莉丝与欧尔·格尔的浴血十字架再战
name.en: Alice and Or-Gaule's Bloody Cross rematch

periods.location: Luxel residential district and church area
periods.summary: Or-Gaule reenacts Alice's childhood massacre with puppets, but Alice's revenge-born will and Invincible Armor let her resist Marionette and nearly kill him.
periods.cause: The war split sends Alice into a residential district where Or-Gaule has prepared a psychological trap based on the Bloody Cross massacre.
periods.process: Alice finds dolls representing villagers hurting each other and begging, including a doll like herself asking Orles to stop. Or-Gaule appears on a chapel roof and treats the reenactment as theater. Alice declares she will kill him. A flashback shows Levi Ascaride giving young Alice the choice to forget or accept responsibility as Or-Gaule's surviving sister; Alice chose the mission to stop him. In the battle, Or-Gaule uses invisible Black Widow threads as aerial footholds, Killing Opera thread slashes, Deus Ex Machina building projectiles, and constant talk of the murdered villagers. He lures Alice into a thread nest and attempts Marionette, but her destiny-like fixation on killing him rejects the control. His slashes and projectiles cannot pierce Invincible Armor. He then rigs a thread around her neck so her own movement strangles her, but Alice ignores suffocation, throws her axe as bait, predicts his thread escape, punches him down, crushes both hands, and begins strangling him.
periods.outcome: Or-Gaule escapes only when Alice spasms from oxygen deprivation and he manipulates threads with his toes. He flees upward badly injured.
periods.aftermath: Stella appears in the sky and cuts off Or-Gaule's escape with dragon fire, shifting the fight toward a team finish.
casualties: or-gaule's hands crushed and throat damaged
alice-ascaride suffers strangulation and neck wounds
periods.significance: Shows Alice has grown specifically to counter her brother's control and proves Or-Gaule can be physically cornered despite his web of tricks.
